candidates.name: Tristate Material Services
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage says they 'sell and install Division 10, 11, and 12 products', with toilet partitions in the list; works with large general contractors. The project gallery lists schools, hospitals and senior living near Philadelphia but no scope details.
red_flags: Bobrick/Bradley appear in a general vendor logo list, not tied to partitions
candidates.reason: A Division 10 distributor and installer near Philadelphia that names toilet partitions among the products it sells and installs for general contractors.

license.name: Tristate Material Services
license.registry: City of Philadelphia L&I trade licenses (official open data, table trade_licenses)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Searched 'Tristate', 'Tri-State', 'Tri State' and 'Material'. Many unrelated Tri-State businesses came up (masonry, fire protection, construction and others), but none was Tristate Material Services. Also absent from the city business_licenses table. The company is based in Malvern, outside the city, so a city license is needed only for jobs inside Philadelphia. PA AG HIC search was unavailable (HTTP 503) and applies only to residential work anyway.

candidates.name: Widener Specialties & Finishes (Widener Inc.)
candidates.partition_evidence: The CIS listing says Widener installs toilet partitions, lockers and benches. Its own site has an Installation page (own contractor team) and a 'partitions' and 'washroom accessories' product category.
red_flags: Toilet partition installation is stated on a third-party listing; its own site doesn't say partitions explicitly
Represents manufacturers and sells partitions (buy-around risk)
The about page's mailto link points to a personal staff address; use info@ only
candidates.reason: A Bucks County specialties contractor with its own installation crew; a construction-leads listing says it installs toilet partitions. Confirm by phone that partition installation is current.

license.name: Widener Specialties & Finishes (Widener Inc.)
license.registry: City of Philadelphia L&I trade licenses (official open data, table trade_licenses)

candidates.name: Associated Building Specialties
candidates.partition_evidence: The toilet partitions page says 'See our Services tab for Installation & Repairs'; the Services page lists installations by trained technicians, repairs (broken locks, ADA), field checks and custom hardware.
red_flags: Stocking distributor since 1957 that sells partitions and ships nationwide (strong buy-around risk)
candidates.reason: Installs and repairs toilet partitions across the tri-state area from Blackwood, NJ, about 18 miles from Philadelphia. It is also a partitions distributor that competes with us.

candidates.name: Diversified Ceilings Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: The Bathroom Partitions page calls it 'a leading installer of toilet partitions' and says it handles commercial jobs of any size: field measurement, receiving and delivering product, installation and repairs, in steel, stainless, solid plastic, phenolic and laminate.
candidates.reason: A commercial ceiling contractor that explicitly installs toilet partitions and serves NJ and eastern PA, about 25 miles from the area center. Receiving customer-supplied product is part of its service.

candidates.name: Triad Building Specialties Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage describes the company as 'Installer of Toilet Partitions and Bathroom Accessories'; About page says it supplies commercial washroom partitions and accessories (family-run since 1976).
red_flags: Site footer copyright 2010; website looks unmaintained
candidates.reason: Says outright it installs toilet partitions for commercial clients, based in Chester County about 28 miles from the area center. It also supplies partitions, so the listing agreement matters.

license.name: Triad Building Specialties Inc
license.registry: City of Philadelphia L&I trade licenses (official open data, table trade_licenses, includes CONTRACTOR license type; records issued through 2026-11-16)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. No CONTRACTOR (or any) license under 'Triad Building Specialties' or 'Triad'. Only match was an unrelated 'TRIAD MECHANICAL INC' (license 38125, inactive since 2012). The company is based in West Chester, outside Philadelphia city limits. A City Contractor License is needed only for work inside the city, so no license may simply mean no Philadelphia jobs. PA Attorney General Home Improvement Contractor search (hicsearch.attorneygeneral.gov) returned HTTP 503 and a TLS error, so it could not be checked. That registration covers residential home improvement only, not commercial toilet partition work.

candidates.name: KLT Sales & Services Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: The About page lists toilet partitions and toilet room accessories among the products it installs; it is a registered NJ public works contractor serving NJ, DE and PA.
red_flags: Base city not stated on its site (Vineland comes from the candidate list only); Vineland is about 40 miles from the area center
candidates.reason: Installs toilet partitions for institutional and public works clients across the tri-state area, but its likely base in Vineland is beyond the 30-mile radius.

candidates.name: Union Wholesale Company
candidates.partition_evidence: The homepage says it supplies and installs commercial and industrial interior products throughout the Delaware Valley; the product list includes Toilet/Bathroom Partitions. Neither page says it installs partitions specifically.
candidates.reason: A commercial interiors supplier and installer in Wilmington that carries toilet partitions, but it never says outright that it installs partitions.

candidates.name: Unified Door & Hardware Group (Unified Specialty Services)
candidates.partition_evidence: The Division 10 capabilities page lists 'Toilet partitions, accessories, lockers, signage' under What We Do; the company offers installation and distribution services.
red_flags: Mainly a door and hardware company with a nationwide presence; partition installation not shown in projects
candidates.reason: A Pennsauken-based Division 10 provider just across the river from Philadelphia that lists toilet partitions and installation services; partition installs aren't proven.

candidates.name: One Point Partitions
candidates.partition_evidence: The site returned 403. Search snippets show an online seller with delivery terminals (Bensalem PA, Thorofare NJ, Elkton MD) and DIY install guides; one page says there's no need to hire an installation crew.
red_flags: A direct online partitions competitor, not an installer
Bensalem is a delivery terminal, not an installation base
candidates.reason: A national online partitions seller that competes with Next Partitions; no evidence that it installs.

candidates.name: Tracorp
candidates.partition_evidence: Website returned 403. A CIS listing names Southampton, PA and lists toilet partitions and accessories among its products, with no mention of installation.
red_flags: Own website blocked (403); the listing points to tracorp.biz, which did not resolve
Listed in Southampton, not Willow Grove
candidates.reason: No installation evidence could be read: the site is blocked and the only listing shows a product supplier. Recheck by hand before ruling it out.
